description: This is a Python script for creating Android test project files, including Android.mk and AndroidManifest.xml, for testing purposes within an Android development environment.

classes.name: TestsConsts
classes.description: Contains constants used for generating test Android.mk and AndroidManifest.xml files.

methods.name: _GenerateTestManifest
methods.description: Creates and populates a test AndroidManifest.xml file if it does not already exist.

methods.name: _GenerateTestMK
methods.description: Creates and populates a test Android.mk file if it does not already exist.

methods.name: _ParseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for the script.

methods.name: _PrintMessage
methods.description: Prints a message to standard output.

methods.name: _PrintError
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error.

methods.name: _ValidateInputFiles
methods.description: Validates that required variables are defined in the input files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the creation of test project files based on provided application path.
